title: VanillaEmpire+ Modded
body:
### What This Modpack Offers

**Create & Expansions:** Build complex mechanical contraptions with Create and its many addons 

**Decorative Mods:** Extensive decoration options through Handcrafted, Macaw's furniture series, Chipped blocks,Amendments,Supplementaries and Fetzi's decorations.

**Architectural Freedom:** Diagonal Fences, Walls, and Windows 

**Biome Overhauls:** Explore diverse landscapes with Biomes O' Plenty, Oh The Biomes We've Gone, and Terralith terrain generation

**Structure Improvements:** YUNG's suite completely reimagines dungeons, temples, caves, and strongholds for exploration

**New Dimensions:** Venture into The Undergarden

**End Remastered:** A complete overhaul of the End dimension's progression

### 
### Culinary Expansion

Farmer's Delight as the foundation, with expansions for every biome and dimension
Biome-specific cuisines: Ocean's Delight, Nether's Delight and End's Delight

### Performance & Visual Improvements
Enjoy smooth gameplay with modern optimizations:
Sodium, Lithium, and Iris for dramatically improved framerate and shader support
ModernFix, FerriteCore, and EntityCulling reduce memory usage and improve load times
Enhanced Visuals: Dynamic lighting, improved particles with AmbientSounds, and realistic weather with Snow! Real Magic!
Quality-of-Life: BetterF3, Jade for block information, REI for recipe viewing, and Mouse Tweaks

### Multiplayer Ready
Built for playing with friends:

Simple Voice Chat for proximity voice communication
Waystones for convenient travel between bases
Sophisticated Backpacks and Storage for sharing resources

**Why Download This Pack?**
This modpack is perfect for players who want:
Creative building with endless decoration and automation options.
Adventurers wanting fresh exploration with revamped structures and added dimension.
Survival Improvements with meaningful progression through cooking, farming, and crafting
Community players who need performance optimization for multiplayer servers
All-in-one experience that doesn't sacrifice performance for content
